hypothesis: Fixed deterministic request markers at k=5 improve persisted-cache C quality relative to k=0 without making C inferior to fresh independent B or full-reference D beyond the frozen margin.

training.warmup: linear on one-based optimizer steps 1-20 inclusive; step 20 reaches 1e-5; constant 1e-5 thereafter
training.loss_scaling: each presentation loss divided by 4 before backward; one optimizer step after four backwards
training.schedule: arm-independent SHA-256 over v70, seed, global presentation index, and record ID
training.teacher_target: same no-link sequential full-causal target for both arms

runtime_gate.projection: mean measured seconds per optimizer step across both completed 20-step arms multiplied by 2 arms and 1000 requested steps
runtime_gate.adjustment_if_projection_exceeds_cap: floor(21600 / measured_mean_seconds_per_optimizer_step / 2), rounded down to nearest 50, then minimum 300; use exactly that count for both arms
runtime_gate.amendment: record measured timings, projection, and adjusted common step count before either full run
runtime_gate.hard_cap: never knowingly continue training beyond 6 total GPU-hours; if even the minimum adjustment is incompatible, stop

pre_full_run_amendment_1.reason: first budget-smoke attempt failed before step 1 because the new output parent did not exist; runner now creates it and regression test covers a nested absent parent
pre_full_run_amendment_1.smoke_checkpoints_disposition: delete disposable weights; retain loss logs and summary

pre_evaluation_amendment_2.reason: one-record persisted evaluation reproduced B/C equality failure solely because fresh B K/V was GPU-resident and reopened persisted C K/V was CPU-resident
pre_evaluation_amendment_2.infrastructure_fix: _kv_equal requires equal shape and dtype, then compares tensors after detach().cpu()

training.interpretation: convergence diagnostics only; not quality or selection evidence

pre_evaluation_amendment_2.checkpoint_hash_rule: sha256 of JSON mapping every checkpoint-relative file path to its SHA-256, with sorted keys and default JSON separators

pre_confirmation_amendment_3.timing: after development evaluation and selection, before opening any confirmation data or running confirmation
pre_confirmation_amendment_3.selection_rule: lexicographically maximize persisted C exact match, then persisted C token F1, among k0 and k5, only after C is verified as a true reopened persisted-store hit and C-B persistence sanity passes

selection_and_analysis.development_selection: lexicographically maximize persisted C exact match, then persisted C token F1, among k0 and k5, only after C is verified as a true reopened persisted-store hit and C-B persistence sanity passes
selection_and_analysis.pass_rule: both EM and F1 paired 95% CI lower bounds are >= -0.02 for both C-B and C-D
selection_and_analysis.v68_policy: do not use V68 confirmation labels or predictions for selection; report the divergent population post hoc only

amendment_3_dev_selection.selection_rule: lexicographically maximize persisted C EM, then C F1

stop_rules: 20-step projected total exceeds 6h and the predeclared adjustment cannot satisfy the hard cap
NaN or any nonfinite loss, gradient, or trained weight
treatment disconnect or k0/k5 record/schedule mismatch
checkpoint restore metadata or weight mismatch
C is not a true reopened persisted-store hit

commands.next_20_step_smoke: for arm in k0 k5; do CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python scripts/v70_run.py train --arm $arm --steps 20 --checkpoint-dir results/v70_20step_seed47/checkpoint_$arm --seed 47; done
commands.next_dev_k0: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python scripts/v70_run.py evaluate --checkpoint results/v70_arms_valid_seed47/checkpoint_k0 --arm k0 --split dev --output results/v70_dev_k0.json --max-new-tokens 64
commands.next_dev_k5: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python scripts/v70_run.py evaluate --checkpoint results/v70_arms_valid_seed47/checkpoint_k5 --arm k5 --split dev --output results/v70_dev_k5.json --max-new-tokens 64
commands.ruff: ruff check scripts/v70_run.py scripts/v70_harness.py scripts/v70_schedule.py tests/test_v70_harness.py
